conf.description: VMware vCenter EventManager collector / api-pull: no stock Elastic integration ingests the vCenter event log over the API, so a purpose-built govmomi/PowerCLI/VMware Event Broker collector (out of pipeline scope) posts one NDJSON document per Event to a Cribl HTTP Source; this pipeline shapes that already-typed JSON into ECS, per direct.cribl recommendation.

conf.comment: vmware-vsphere / vcenter-events / api-pull. Collector assumption (documented in README, since the map itself says the collector is out of scope for a pipeline-only task): the collector normalizes the Event object's dynamic type (or EventEx.eventTypeId) into a flat JSON key named eventTypeId, and normalizes EventEx.severity / the EventManager.description eventInfo fallback into a flat key named severity -- the map names both properties but not a literal collector output key, so these two field names are an assumption, not the literal SOAP property path. Typed EventArgument objects (host, vm, datacenter, computeResource, ds, net, dvs) are assumed to arrive JSON-nested as e.g. {"vm":{"name":...}}, matching the map's own dotted vendor-column names (vm.name, datacenter.name, ...); host.name needs no rename since source and ECS target are already identical post JSON-parse.

functions.description: document the collector-normalization assumptions this pipeline depends on
parse the NDJSON Event document the out-of-scope EventManager collector posted to the HTTP Source
set _time from the event's own createdTime (xsd:dateTime), not the collector's poll time (constraint 1: never target @timestamp directly)

per direct.cribl/direct.elastic: derive numeric event.severity from the collector-normalized severity word while carrying the 'user' marker as its own flag, split userName into user.name/user.domain, wrap the role name into the ECS array field, and keep the numeric roleId (a stable join key the syslog feed does not have) as a custom field

batch every straight 1:1 copy: the API delivers typed properties (mostly renames and MoRef-name lifts per parsing.notes, not a positional grok). host.name is already correctly placed post JSON-parse and needs no entry here
tag the event with its dataset
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
